modmenu.descriptionTranslation.spearswap: Fixes the 26.3 spear lunge animation bug: after attacking with a spear and swapping to another item, the new item kept the spear's long lunge/stab animation. Restores the 1.21.11 behaviour, where the swing follows the item you are currently holding. Client-side and visual only; can be toggled in Mod Menu.
spearswapfix.config.title: Spear Swap Fix
spearswapfix.config.enabled.tooltip: On: after swapping away from a spear, the held item uses its own swing (like 1.21.11). Off: vanilla 26.3 behaviour.
